required_readme_fragments: The preregistered Private Debt Investor record-level enumeration/export was not accessible: the inspected public response required sign-in/account creation and exposed neither provider record IDs nor historical version/as-of timestamps. Public sponsor pages supplied isolated examples, not a complete regional fund universe. Therefore missing search hits cannot be coded as zero-event months, event-count thresholds cannot be evaluated, and no point-in-time monthly proxy can be constructed without selection/backfill bias.
